title: Houthis Threaten to Expand Red Sea Attacks, and Claim Strikes on Saudi Tankers
summary_full: Saudi Arabia has not commented on the claims by the Houthis, who are backed by Iran and have vowed to close “all access routes” to Saudi oil shipments.
